paper.title: 写作08｜引言与相关工作写作 — intrograph skill
target_claims: The Skill builds four checkable ledgers (citations, grouping, gap, contribution-evidence) before any prose, then audits the draft with 18 deterministic checks.
On the bundled clean fixture the draft passes all 18 checks with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
On 21 planted writing defects the audit catches 21/21 across all 18 rules.
A Chinese manuscript with numeric citations resolves and renders GB/T 7714; an English one renders IEEE, with the bibliography numbered by the draft's own citation numbers.

expected_outputs.name: Skill entry point and usage contract
Four ledgers written before the prose
Manuscript-ready introduction and related work (example run)
Honest degradation with no reference library

provenance.toolchain: official DeepSeek Harness; Python 3.14.6 standard library only

handoff.hypothesis: If the four ledgers are written before the prose and the 18 deterministic checks are run after it, then the same materials yield fewer invented citations, fewer uncited claims, no paper-by-paper related work, and contributions that resolve to the manuscript's own figures, tables and reported numbers, compared with a base agent writing the same section directly.
handoff.next_suggestion: The platform runs the three official cases with and without this Skill; run `python3 src/reproduce.py` to reproduce the local evidence (28/28 assertions, 21/21 planted defects, 1.8 s, no network, no third-party package).
handoff.next_owner_hint: Human reviewer: README.md sections 1-2 for the interface, then execution/results/defective/defects_detected.json for the per-defect evidence table, then references/failure-modes.md for what the checks deliberately do not catch.

modality_notes.execution: src/reproduce.py is the entry point; it drives scripts/run_case.py through plan/audit/finalize on four fixtures and writes execution/results/.
modality_notes.skills: The deliverables under SKILL.md, references/ and scripts/ are the Skill itself; this bundle is the Skill package, not a paper reproduction.
modality_notes.characterization: Local self-test only. The 'paper' here is a fictional fixture, so deviations_from_paper measures self-test assertions, not agreement with a published figure.
modality_notes.trace: Session trace of the authoring run: reading the challenge, building the engines, running the self-test, fixing the two defects the self-test caught.
